name: Tidemark
summary: Slate and sea-teal project app for an engineering practice: field map, workload, visits, drawings
about: A complete project and task app for a small team, shown with a made-up eight-person engineering practice that splits its time between the office and building sites. A live field map tracks crews between sites, a workload grid books hours per person per week, and site visits, RFIs, snags and a drawing register keep the field work in order. Good for engineering, surveying, architecture and other field teams.
how: Ops shows the field map: sites are coloured by stage, crew vans drive their routes live and Ping crews runs a sonar sweep. Click a site to open the project.
On Workload, drag a booking to another person or week, use the ⋯ menu to push it along, or click an empty cell to book hours. Red cells are overbooked.
On Site visits, plan a visit, then on the day tick the safety checklist to check in. The timer runs in the top bar and Check out logs time on site.
RFIs & snags lists every question and defect with severity, reply dates, a thread and photos. Raise new ones from any project.
Drawings is the register: issue a new revision with a note and it joins the history with the next letter.
Projects, Reports and Settings cover fees used, utilisation, the theme, live tracking and Reset demo data.
